job.title: Permanent - PR and Campaign Manager CANAL+ Belgium @ CANAL+ GROUP (BRU, BE)
job.description:
**About CANAL+Group**  
  
Founded as a French subscription-TV channel 40 years ago, CANAL+ is now a global media and entertainment company. On 22 September 2025, CANAL+ confirmed it is in effective control of MultiChoice Group and beginning the integration process. **MultiChoice** is Africa’s leading entertainment platform, offering a wide range of products and services, including DStv, GOtv, Showmax, M-Net, SuperSport, Irdeto, and KingMakers. Together, the new combined group has 40 million subscribers worldwide, operates in over 70 countries and has approximately 17,000 employees.
  
  
CANAL+ operates across the entire audio-visual value chain, including production, broadcast, distribution and aggregation. It is home to **STUDIOCANAL**, a leading film and television studio with worldwide production and distribution capabilities; **Dailymotion**, major international video platform powered by cutting-edge proprietary technology for video delivery, advertising, and monetization; **CANAL+ Distribution,** a production and distribution company specialising in creating and distributing diverse content and channels; and telecommunication services, through **GVA** in Africa and **CANAL+ Telecom** in the French overseas jurisdictions and territories.
  
  
CANAL+ also has significant equity stakes in **Viaplay** (the Pay-TV leader in Scandinavia) and **Viu** (a leading OTT platform in Southern Asia).

**Lead the Stories That Shape Our Brand**

  

At CANAL+ Belgium, we are transforming the way people connect with entertainment, sports content, and technology. We are looking for a dynamic and creative PR & Campaign Manager to lead the execution of impactful communication campaigns and public relations initiatives that strengthen brand awareness, support commercial objectives, and enhance the visibility of CANAL+ in Belgium.

Reporting directly to the Director of Brand & Marketing Communications, this role combines creativity, project management, media relations, and campaign execution to ensure that CANAL+ consistently delivers compelling stories and high-impact marketing initiatives across all audiences and channels.

**Your mission**

  

As PR & Campaign Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing integrated marketing campaigns and public relations activities that support the growth and positioning of the CANAL+ brand in Belgium.

  

**Your key responsibilities will include**

  

* Managing the day-to-day execution of marketing and communication campaigns across paid, owned, and earned media channels.

* Coordinating the development and localization of campaign assets in collaboration with creative agencies, production partners, media agencies, and internal stakeholders.

* Developing campaigns and PR initiatives to support the launch and promotion of CANAL+ content, products, services, partnerships, and corporate initiatives.

* Establishing and maintaining strong relationships with journalists, media organizations, influencers, industry associations, and external stakeholders.

* Preparing and distributing press releases, media briefings, interview materials, Q&As, and corporate communication content.

* Organizing press events, media screenings, sponsorship activations, and corporate events to maximize brand visibility and stakeholder engagement.

* Monitoring media coverage and managing media requests while ensuring timely and consistent company responses.

* Coordinating communication around key business milestones, content launches, and strategic announcements.

* Working closely with digital / e-commerce, customer lifecycle, content, and commercial teams to ensure integrated campaign execution and messaging consistency.

* Managing campaign timelines, agency deliverables, budgets, and reporting.

* Tracking campaign and PR performance, analyzing results, and identifying optimization opportunities.

* Monitoring industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities to enhance communication effectiveness and brand relevance.

* Acting as a brand ambassador by ensuring compliance with CANAL+ brand guidelines across all communication activities.

  

**What You Bring**

  

We are looking for a proactive communication professional who combines creativity with strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.

  

Experience & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field.

* Minimum 5 to 8 years of experience in communications, public relations, campaign management, marketing communications, or a related field.

* Experience within media, entertainment, telecommunications, consumer brands, digital platforms, subscription businesses, or agency environments is highly valued.

* Proven experience managing integrated communication or marketing campaigns from concept to execution.

* Strong understanding of media relations, content creation, event management, and modern communication channels.

* Experience working with agencies, media partners, and external suppliers.

* Fluency in Dutch and French, with strong professional English skills.

  

Personal Attributes

* Excellent communication and storytelling abilities.

* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

* Creative mindset with strong attention to detail.

* Results-oriented and proactive, with a hands-on approach.

* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

* Collaborative team player with a positive and solution-oriented attitude.

* Passion for media, entertainment, sports, content and consumer brands.

  

**Why Join CANAL+ Belgium?**

  

Joining CANAL+ Belgium means becoming part of an international media and entertainment group that is continuously redefining how audiences experience content. You will play a key role in building the visibility and reputation of the CANAL+ brand in Belgium, contribute to the successful launch and growth of exciting content and offers, and work alongside passionate professionals in a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry.

job.title: Head Commercial & Portfolio Mgmt @ UCB (Anderlecht, BRU, BE)
job.description:
**Make your mark for patients**

We are looking for a **Global Head Commercial & Portfolio Management** who is collaborative, curious and care-focused to join our Developed Brands team, based at our UCB offices in Brussels, Belgium. We are also open to hire in the other tier UCB Hub locations Slough UK and Monheim Germany.

**About the role**

You will shape global commercial and portfolio strategies for established medicines, connecting scientific evidence with the everyday needs of patients, healthcare professionals and payers. Bringing a human perspective to complex choices, you will balance patient impact, sustainable growth, investment and lifecycle opportunities across markets. You will translate insights into practical plans, explore new digital approaches and foster thoughtful decisions that sustain long-term portfolio value. You will also develop your team’s capabilities, creating space for curiosity, collaboration and accountability.

**Who you will work with**

You will work closely with the Head of Late Lifecycle Assets and manage three marketing team members whose development you will support. Across global, regional and country teams, you will collaborate with commercial, medical, market access, regulatory, supply and operational excellence colleagues. You will also connect with external partners and strategic agencies. Together, you will bring different perspectives into portfolio decisions and translate shared priorities into meaningful action, fostering a supportive environment built on trust, learning and shared accountability.

**What you will do**

* Set and lead the global commercial and portfolio management strategies for the late lifecycle assets within Developed Brands.
* Enable portfolio maximization and prioritization across markets balancing growth, profitability, investment choices, lifecycle opportunities, risk management and resource allocation across assets, channels and geographies that accounts for more than €1.8B in net sales worldwide.
* Be the commercial leader for the portfolio translating enterprice objectives into differentiated asset and portfolio strategies that improve patient impact, sustain competitiveness and deliver revenue, EBIT and long-term value commitments.
* Lead integrated portfolio governance and decision making ensuring clear prioritization, trade-off recommendations and scenario planning across assets.
* Build and lead a high-performing team creating a culture of trust, accountability, innovation, enterprise thinking and measurable impact.
* Foster digital innovation and artificial intelligence applications that improve engagement and efficiency.

**Interested? For this role, we are looking for the following education, experience, and skills**

* Bachelors / Masters degree
* At least fifteen years’ experience in pharmaceuticals, medical devices or biotechnology.
* Two years in country/regional roles across Europe, Intercontinental markets or the United States.
* Established medicines commercial strategy and implementation experience; neurology experience preferred.
* Experience developing global/local teams, fostering collaboration and translating complex concepts into clear communication.
* Strategic judgement, stakeholder engagement, business case development and complex project management skills.
* Strong financial and business acumen and strong data analytics capabilities.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

**About us**  
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

**Why work with us?**  
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.  
  
Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable\_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

job.title: Strategy Manager - Go-to-Market @ Proximus (Brussels, BRU, BE)
job.description:
Proximus Global, combining the strengths of Telesign, BICS, and Route Mobile, is shaping the future of communications and digital identity.

Our mission is simple : to enable seamless global connectivity and trusted engagements that power the world's interactions.

Together, our solutions fuel innovation across the world's largest companies and emerging brands. With a truly global reach, we enable businesses to create engaging customer experiences while integrating fraud protection across the entire lifecycle.

Our portfolio covers global voice, messaging and data connectivity, alongside 5G and IoT solutions. It also includes digital identity, verification and CPaaS platforms for personalised, omnichannel engagement. Through these capabilities, we help businesses and communities stay connected, secure and ready to grow. Today, we reach more than 5 billion subscribers, secure over 180 billion transactions every year, and connect more than 1,000 destinations worldwide — delivering on our commitment to connect, protect and engage everywhere.

**Key highlights**
------------------

Powering more than **13 billion** digital communications every month

Supporting over **3,500** active customers through a presence in **50+** global offices across **100+** countries

Managing **50%** of global roaming data traffic and connecting **150 million** IoT devices

Driving innovation in **5G**, private networks and IoT, reinforcing our position in next-generation communications

**About us**

Proximus Global brings together Telesign, Route Mobile and Masiv to help enterprises protect and engage their customers. Our solutions span digital identity, fraud prevention, verification and Network APIs (Protect), and omnichannel communications such as SMS, RCS, WhatsApp and voice (Engage).

Growth Marketing sits inside the Protect & Engage business unit and turns product value into measurable, scalable revenue. The team has five pillars: Go-to-Market Strategy, Regional Marketing, Paid Media, Account-Based Marketing and Inbound SDRs.

**The role**

You will lead Go-to-Market Strategy for the Protect & Engage business unit and decide where we play, who we target and how we win. Today our ICPs and personas exist, but we need someone who sharpens it into clear priorities, use cases and value propositions that sales and marketing can act on.

You report to the Head of Growth Marketing and lead and coach the GtM specialists. You are the senior GtM counterpart for Product, Sales, Partnerships and Regional Marketing.  
The role is based in Belgium, with occasional international travel.

**What we mean by GtM strategy**

GtM strategy is how we take a product to a market and win there: where we play, who buys and why, what we offer them, how we reach and sell to them, and how we measure success.  
For example: AI-native companies, such as AI app builders and voice AI platforms, are growing fast. You would work out what they need, where our products fit and how we should sell to them, then turn that into a plan sales and marketing can run. Often there is no playbook yet: you build it.

**Key responsibilities**

Set GtM strategy and priorities

* Define the GtM priorities for the next 6-12 months across Protect and Engage: segments, verticals, countries and priority use cases
* Answer "where do we win first" with clear, data-backed choices, and say what we stop doing
* Build GtM strategies from scratch for new segments, such as AI-native companies

Own segmentation, ICPs and value propositions

* Own segmentation, ICPs and personas, and keep them current
* Define priority use cases per industry and a clear messaging hierarchy, from core message to industry narratives
* Build differentiated value propositions and competitive positioning

Lead product launches and strategic initiatives

* Shape the GtM plan for new products and launches with Product Marketing, Regional Marketing and
* Sales: target accounts, channels, sales motion and success metrics  
  Bring the GtM view into product planning (PI planning, roadmap reviews)

Equip sales and marketing

* Give sales clear pitch decks, sales plays, case studies and testimonials focused on customer problems
* Give Regional Marketing, ABM and Paid Media the priorities, audiences and messages to build campaigns on

Bring the customer and market voice in

* Own customer feedback: run interviews, market research and an Executive Advisory Board with key customers
* Track the market and competitors, and feed insights to Product and leadership

Lead and coach the GtM team

* Coach and develop the GtM specialist, raising the bar on strategic thinking and structure
* Set the GtM way of working: templates, intake and prioritisation of requests, and clear handoffs to execution teams

**Requirements**

  

* 10+ years in go-to-market strategy, product marketing, strategy consulting or growth roles in B2B tech,
* SaaS, API or telecom businesses
* Proven record of designing GtM strategies from scratch for new segments, markets or products, and seeing them through to measurable pipeline or revenue
* Strong structured thinking: turns ambiguous questions into clear choices, frameworks and recommendations a leadership team can decide on
* Deep experience with segmentation, ICP and persona definition, value propositions and competitive positioning
* Comfortable getting to grips with fast-moving new markets, including AI-native and developer-led companies
* Credible with senior stakeholders in Product, Sales and leadership; able to challenge and align them  
  Experience coaching or managing marketers or strategists
* Fluent English, written and spoken

**Strong plus**

  

* Experience in CPaaS (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, voice) and Digital Identity (verification, authentication, fraud
* prevention, Network APIs) is a major advantage.

**Why Proximus Global?**
------------------------

### **Global & Inclusive**

Work with diverse teams across 100+ countries, in a truly international and connected environment.

### **Ownership & Trust**

Take initiative, make decisions and own your impact with real autonomy.

### **Innovation with Purpose**

Contribute to meaningful solutions in global connectivity, combining technology, platforms and expertise across Proximus Global.

### **Growth Mindset**

Continuously learn, challenge the status quo, and grow across our global organisation.

job.title: Content Marketeer @ ELIX Group (Tynaarlo, DR, NL)
job.description:
Standplaats: Tynaarlo (hybride)
  
32 – 40 uur

**ELIX gidst ondernemers naar de nieuwe energiesituatie. Eén partner voor je volledige energievraagstuk.**

Stijgende energieprijzen, netcongestie en onzekerheid over de energievoorziening stellen bedrijven voor grote uitdagingen. Als integrale energiepartner biedt ELIX hiervoor één totaaloplossing. Van advies en ontwerp tot de realisatie van zonnepanelen, batterijopslag en laadinfrastructuur. Met onze eigen software, slimme energiesturing en energielevering brengen we alles samen in één slim energiesysteem.

Het resultaat? De meest betrouwbare energievoorziening tegen de beste prijs per kWh. Meer grip op je energiekosten, optimaal gebruik van je beschikbare energie en de zekerheid om ongestoord te blijven ondernemen. Dat noemen wij onverwoestbare energie. En jij gaat ons verhaal vertellen.

**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------

Als Content Marketeer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de volledige contentaanpak van ELIX. Van strategie en planning tot creatie, distributie en optimalisatie: jij neemt de regie en zorgt ervoor dat onze verhalen bijdragen aan merkvoorkeur, online vindbaarheid en leadgeneratie.

Je bent een sterke schrijver die complexe onderwerpen weet te vertalen naar heldere, overtuigende B2B-content. Denk aan artikelen over netcongestie, actuele content die inspeelt op ontwikkelingen in de energiemarkt, inspirerende klantcases, whitepapers en scherpe LinkedIn-posts namens onze experts en directie. Je haalt kennis op binnen de organisatie, signaleert relevante ontwikkelingen en vertaalt die naar content die onze doelgroep echt verder helpt.

Maar je kijkt verder dan alleen de inhoud. Je begrijpt hoe zoekgedrag verandert en zorgt ervoor dat ELIX zichtbaar is in Google en AI-zoekomgevingen. Je zet AI-tools slim in om efficiënter te werken, analyseert de prestaties van onze content en blijft onze aanpak verbeteren.Je werkt nauw samen met onze specialisten op het gebied van online marketing, video en design. Jij bewaakt de inhoudelijke lijn, stelt prioriteiten en zorgt ervoor dat goede ideeën daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd.

**Wie ben jij?**
----------------

Je bent een nieuwsgierige en ondernemende contentmarketeer die energie krijgt van sterke verhalen en van de resultaten die ze opleveren. Je schrijft graag, denkt strategisch en hebt gevoel voor commercie. Je vindt het leuk om complexe onderwerpen te doorgronden en begrijpelijk te maken voor onze doelgroep.

Je wacht niet op een briefing, maar neemt zelf initiatief. Je ziet kansen, brengt structuur aan en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en prestaties van onze content. Daarnaast volg je nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en ontdek je graag hoe AI en slimme tools je werk beter en efficiënter kunnen maken.

**Dit heb je zo ongeveer in huis…**
-----------------------------------

* **Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau** en minimaal drie jaar relevante ervaring in contentmarketing, copywriting of een vergelijkbare functie.
* **Sterke schrijfvaardigheden:** je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend en weet complexe B2B-onderwerpen te vertalen naar heldere, overtuigende content.
* **Strategisch en organisatorisch vermogen:** je kunt zelfstandig een contentstrategie en -planning ontwikkelen, prioriteiten stellen en de uitvoering coördineren.
* **Kennis van SEO:** je begrijpt hoe je content vindbaar maakt en volgt met interesse de ontwikkelingen rondom AI-search, GEO en AEO.
* **Affiniteit met AI en marketingtechnologie:** je experimenteert graag met nieuwe tools en gebruikt data om je werk te verbeteren.

Ervaring in de energie- of techsector is mooi meegenomen, net als kennis van Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console of SEO-tools zoals Ahrefs en Semrush. Belangrijker vinden we dat je nieuwsgierig bent, snel leert en verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen.

**Zo ziet een voorbeeldweek eruit**
-----------------------------------

Je begint de week op ons kantoor in Tynaarlo met de weekstart van het marketingteam. We bespreken de lopende campagnes, bekijken de prestaties van recent gepubliceerde content en bepalen de prioriteiten. Daarna werk je aan de contentplanning voor een nieuwe campagne gericht op de logistieke sector.

Dinsdag verschijnt er een belangrijk nieuwsbericht over netcongestie. Je ziet direct de relevantie voor onze doelgroep, schakelt met een interne expert en schrijft een sterk achtergrondartikel. Met behulp van AI versnel je je research en maak je een scherpe LinkedIn-post namens onze directie.

Woensdag interview je een klant over de uitdagingen rondom zijn energievoorziening. Je vertaalt het gesprek naar een overtuigende klantcase en stemt met onze vormgever en mediaspecialist af hoe we het verhaal ook visueel kunnen vertellen.

De rest van de week optimaliseer je bestaande content voor Google en AI-zoekomgevingen, werk je aan een whitepaper en analyseer je de resultaten van recente publicaties. Je sluit de week af met een bijgewerkte contentplanning en een gezellige borrel met het team.

**Het team waarin je terechtkomt**
----------------------------------

Je komt terecht in een compact en ambitieus marketingteam waarin verschillende specialismen samenkomen. job.title: B2B Brand Manager @ Treatwell (Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
At Treatwell, we believe self-care should be effortless. We're on a mission to make booking beauty and wellness treatments as easy as ordering your morning flat white.
  
  
But our marketplace only works because of the brilliant professionals behind it. From independent hairdressers and beauty therapists to growing salon groups, we help more than 95,000 partners run their businesses, reach new clients and spend more time doing what they do best.
  
  
We're looking for a B2B Brand Manager to lead how Treatwell shows up to the professional beauty industry across Europe.
  
  
Reporting to our Head of Brand, you'll own our B2B brand and brand marketing strategy, building Treatwell's reputation as the partner that helps beauty businesses succeed. You'll turn our proposition into campaigns, content, experiences and stories that resonate with both existing partners and the salons we want to join us next.
  
  
This is a broad, hands-on role spanning strategy and execution. You'll build advocacy programmes, lead European events and trade shows, develop B2B campaigns and work closely with local teams to bring the salon partner community to life.
  
  
You'll understand how to build a brand, but you'll also care about what the work delivers. You'll use performance data, partner insight and experimentation to continually strengthen our message, content and impact.
  
  
**Requirements**
**You will be responsible for:**

* Owning our B2B brand strategy: Lead the development and activation of Treatwell's B2B brand proposition, messaging and narrative across Europe.
* Building a brand the industry believes in: Establish Treatwell as a credible, distinctive and valuable voice within the professional hair, beauty and wellness industry.
* Creating campaigns that drive growth: Develop integrated B2B campaigns that build awareness, consideration and demand among new and prospective salon partners.
* Turning partners into advocates: Build and scale ambassador, influencer and advocacy programmes that put real industry voices at the heart of our marketing.
* Leading our events strategy: Own Treatwell's presence at events, trade shows and industry moments across Europe, from strategy and creative concept through to activation and measurement.
* Activating our partner community: Work with local marketing and marketing teams to create market-relevant initiatives that engage salon partners, strengthen relationships and bring the Treatwell community together.
* Driving B2B storytelling: Find and tell compelling stories about our partners, our technology and the future of the industry across campaigns, content, PR and owned channels.
* Creating content that performs: Lead the development and optimisation of B2B content and advertising across organic and paid social, using insights and testing to improve relevance, engagement and conversion.
* Experimenting and learning: Test new messages, formats, channels and creative approaches, using AI and emerging tools to accelerate production, learn faster and scale what works.
* Building our industry reputation: Partner closely with the PR Manager to develop thought leadership, partner stories, industry commentary and moments that strengthen Treatwell's authority and influence.
* Improving the partner experience: Shape offline and printed brand touchpoints, including welcome packs, event materials, sales collateral and partner communications.
* Connecting global and local: Create clear strategies, toolkits and assets that give local teams the flexibility to activate effectively while strengthening one consistent Treatwell brand.
* Measuring brand impact: Define success metrics and report on the contribution of B2B brand activity to awareness, reputation, engagement, partner acquisition and retention.
* Working cross-functionally: Collaborate with Brand, Creative, Content, Social, PR, Product Marketing, Commercial, Partner Success and local market teams to deliver joined-up work.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant experience in B2B brand marketing, ideally within a marketplace, technology, SaaS, beauty, hospitality or partner-led business.
* A strong understanding of brand strategy, positioning, propositions and messaging, with the ability to turn strategy into effective marketing activity.
* Experience developing integrated B2B campaigns across paid, owned, earned and offline channels.
* Proven experience building ambassador, advocacy, influencer or community programmes.
* Experience delivering events, activations or trade shows, ideally across multiple European markets.
* A strong storyteller who can turn products, partner experiences and industry insight into clear, compelling narratives.
* A performance mindset, with experience using data, testing and audience insight to optimise content and campaigns.
* An experimental approach and genuine curiosity about how AI and emerging tools can improve marketing effectiveness.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to move confidently between long-term strategy and hands-on delivery.
* Experience working with creative teams and agencies to develop distinctive, high-quality work.
* Confidence working across markets, functions and seniority levels, bringing people together around a shared direction.
* Commercial judgement and an understanding of how brand marketing can support acquisition, engagement, retention and long-term business growth.

**You'll Thrive Here If**

* You're as comfortable writing a proposition as you are delivering a trade show.
* You understand that the strongest B2B brands are built through people, proof and community, not corporate language.
* You want to make B2B marketing feel as creatively ambitious as consumer marketing.
* You spot the story inside a product feature, partner success or industry shift.
* You're proactive, collaborative and comfortable building new programmes from the ground up.
* You balance bold ideas with sharp execution and measurable outcomes.

**Benefits**
**About Treatwell**
Hi, we're Treatwell. Nice to meet you.
  
  
We're a team of 700 passionate and brilliantly talented people across Europe. We're the industry's smartest salon management software, all connected to Europe's leading bookings platform, working with over 95,000 salon partners across 14 countries, processing over 8 million bookings every month. And....breathe.
  
  
But we're not done yet. We're on an exciting journey to digitally revolutionise the hair and beauty community.
  
  
If this excites you, we might just have the role for you.

job.title: Commercial Video Content Creative (m/w/d) - Schwerpunkt Social Ads @ Butternut Box (Berlin, BE, DE)
job.description:
**Frischgekocht. Glückliche Hunde.**
------------------------------------

Wir finden: Hunde verdienen die gesündesten, natürlichsten und leckersten Mahlzeiten – ganz ohne unnötige Zusatzstoffe. Deshalb bereiten wir unser Futter frisch zu, so wie du es auch zu Hause machen würdest und liefern es perfekt portioniert direkt zu unseren Kunden.

Als B Corp-zertifiziertes Unternehmen ist uns wichtig, verantwortungsvoll zu wachsen und dabei unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Produkte und unseren Einfluss auf den Planeten im Blick zu behalten. Unsere Mission ist ganz einfach: Wir möchten Hunden dabei helfen, gesünder, glücklicher und länger zu leben und gleichzeitig dafür sorgen, dass auch die Menschen nach jeder Begegnung mit Butternut ein Lächeln im Gesicht haben.

Seit unsere Gründer Kev und Dave die allererste Butternut Box noch persönlich ausgeliefert haben, ist einiges passiert. Heute versorgen wir Hunderttausende hungrige Hunde in Großbritannien und Europa, aber wir hören erst auf, wenn Hunde überall in den Genuss von Butternut kommen. Dafür brauchen wir großartige Menschen, die diese Ambition mit uns teilen und gemeinsam mit uns weiterwachsen möchten.

Unser Berliner Office liegt zentral in Mitte. Hier arbeitest du mit einem kleinen Team von rund 12 Kolleg:innen zusammen und natürlich gehören auch einige vierbeinige Teammitglieder fest zum Büroalltag dazu. Hunde sind bei uns jederzeit willkommen

### **Über die Rolle**

Wir suchen einen Commercial Video Content Creative (m/w/d), der ein starkes Gespür für gute Inhalte mitbringt und gleichzeitig versteht, was Video-Ads erfolgreich macht. In dieser Rolle unterstützt du uns dabei, die Butternut Box Brand in Deutschland und Italien weiter auszubauen.

Ein großer Teil deiner Arbeit besteht aus Konzeption, Lokalisierung, Transcreation, Editing und der Weiterentwicklung bereits erfolgreicher Ad Assets für unsere Growth Channels. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Brand & Creative Team, unserem Growth-Team sowie internationalen Kolleg zusammen. Die Rolle passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn du gerne schnell umsetzt, verschiedene kreative Ansätze testest und Spaß daran hast, Content anhand von Daten und Performance kontinuierlich zu optimieren.

Setup: Die Rolle ist hybrid und in Berlin angesiedelt. Dienstags und freitags kannst du aus dem Homeoffice arbeiten.

### **Deine Aufgaben**

* Du erstellst, lokalisierst und skalierst Paid-Social-Video-Ads für Meta, TikTok und YouTube. Im Schnitt produzierst oder lokalisierst du 5–6 neue Creatives pro Woche und Markt.
* Du entwickelst und testest aufmerksamkeitsstarke Video-Konzepte, Hooks und Botschaften und optimierst sie kontinuierlich auf Basis von Creative Briefings, Performance-Daten und aktuellen Social-Media-Trends.
* Du passt international erfolgreiche Creatives für den deutschen und italienischen Markt an und berücksichtigst dabei lokale Besonderheiten, Trends und kulturelle Unterschiede. Dabei arbeitest du auch mit AI-Voice-over-Tools.
* Du erstellst Short-Form-Videos und Motion-Design-Assets mit After Effects.
* Du produzierst und bearbeitest längere Videoformate mit Premiere Pro.
* Du entwickelst Ideen für Short-Form-Content, filmst und führst Regie – mit Hunden, Hundebesitzer:innen, unseren Produkten und allem, was unsere Marke ausmacht, sowohl am Set als auch unterwegs.
* Gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus Brand, Growth und Copywriting übersetzt du Marketing-Briefings und Performance-Insights in starke visuelle Geschichten.

### **Das bringst du mit**

Wir suchen jemanden, der kreative Qualität mit Schnelligkeit, einem guten Verständnis für Performance und einer ausgeprägten Test-and-Learn-Mentalität verbindet.

Was wir suchen:

* Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
* Du hast Erfahrung darin, Content-Konzepte zu entwickeln und Inhalte für unterschiedliche Märkte zu lokalisieren.
* Du kannst Creative Briefings und Performance-Daten schnell erfassen und daraus Paid-Social-Content entwickeln, der Ergebnisse liefert.
* Du arbeitest sicher mit Video-Editing- und Motion-Design-Tools wie After Effects und Premiere Pro.
* Du verstehst die wichtigsten Prinzipien von Direct Response Creative, zum Beispiel starke Hooks, gutes Pacing und Storytelling und weißt, wie du Ad-Metriken nutzt, um Creatives und Business Impact zu verbessern.
* Du arbeitest schnell, eigenständig und strukturiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten, engen Deadlines und häufigen Iterationen den Überblick.
* Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Bildkomposition, Framing und Licht bei Short-Form-Video.
* Und ganz wichtig: Du liebst Hunde!

Nice to have – je mehr, desto besser:

* Italienischkenntnisse
* Erfahrung mit AI-gestützten Creative-Tools oder automatisierten Video-Plattformen wie ElevenLabs oder SolidLabs

**Was wir bieten**

* Ein attraktives Gehalt und Unternehmensanteile (ESOP), damit du auch an unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg beteiligt bist.
* 25 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr plus einen zusätzlichen Tag für jedes Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit, bis zu insgesamt 29 Tagen.
* 5 zusätzliche bezahlte „Paws Days" pro Jahr für deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung oder spontane Auszeiten.
* Ein jährliches Budget von 500 € für deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterbildung.
* Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft oder monatlichen Gutschein-Optionen.
* Ein Budget, damit du auch an deinen Homeoffice-Tagen bestens ausgestattet bist
* Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsame Aktivitäten, bei denen auch der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt.
* Jährliches Volunteering während der Arbeitszeit, um gemeinsam etwas zurückzugeben.
Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Butternut Box für dich sowie für deine Familie und Freunde.

* **Der Interviewprozess**

* Erstes Kennenlerngespräch mit deinem Talent Acquisition Partner, remote.

* Eine erste Aufgabe, bei der du direkt zeigen kannst, was in dir steckt.

* Skills Interview, remote.

* Behaviour Interview, persönlich vor Ort.

* Ein lockerer Coffee Chat vor Ort mit zwei Teammitgliedern.

*In der Regel dauert unser gesamter Interviewprozess etwa 3–5 Wochen.*

Wichtige Hinweise:

* Wir empfehlen dir, dich möglichst frühzeitig zu bewerben. Sobald wir ausreichend passende Bewerbungen erhalten haben, behalten wir uns vor, die Stelle vorzeitig zu schließen.
* Zusammenarbeit ist ein wichtiger Teil unserer Kultur. Deshalb verbringen wir drei Tage pro Woche gemeinsam in unserem Berliner Office: Montags, mittwochs und donnerstags. An den anderen beiden Tagen kannst du von dort arbeiten, wo du am produktivsten bist. Daher suchen wir für diese Rolle jemanden, für den der regelmäßige Weg nach Berlin gut machbar ist.
* Unser Recruiting-Team ist klein und wir nehmen uns die Zeit, jede Bewerbung sorgfältig anzuschauen. Deshalb kann es manchmal etwas dauern, bis du von uns hörst. Danke für deine Geduld.
* Für diese Rolle können wir leider kein Visa Sponsorship anbieten. Du benötigst daher bereits eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland.

### **❗️****Wir glauben daran, dass jede Stimme einen Platz am Tisch verdient.**

Butternut Box ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt. Wir sind überzeugt: Um das beste Futter für alle Hunde herzustellen, brauchen wir ein Team, das die Vielfalt aller Menschen widerspiegelt. Deshalb schätzen wir unterschiedliche Nationalitäten, Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven.

Wir setzen uns aktiv dafür ein, die Repräsentation von unterrepräsentierten Gruppen zu stärken und ein vielfältiges Team aufzubauen, das von unterschiedlichen Identitäten und Lebenserfahrungen geprägt ist.

Wir sind noch nicht am Ziel - aber wir arbeiten jeden Tag daran, ein inklusives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem du einfach du selbst sein und wachsen kannst.

Wenn diese Rolle dein Hundeherz höherschlagen lässt, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und dein Portfolio

job.title: Influencer Marketing Manager (d/f/m) @ TaxFix (Berlin, BE, DE)
job.description:
**Our story:**
--------------

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

**The opportunity:**
--------------------

We're now growing our consumer business and building new services for self-employed people and freelancers. To support that, we're looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to run creator campaigns for Taxfix and Steuerbot.

Most people find taxes stressful. Hearing from a creator they already trust that they got money back in one evening is more convincing than an ad. That's why creators are a big part of our marketing. We run the channel in-house with a significant yearly budget and use it both to bring in new users and to build trust in our brands. The hard part is doing both at once: getting new users at a good cost while keeping the content credible for the creator's audience.

This role reports to the Influencer Marketing Lead and focuses at first on our two German brands, Taxfix and Steuerbot.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run and scale creator campaigns from start to finish: find creators, reach out, negotiate, brief them, review content, take it live and report on results.
* Negotiate deals that make sense for both sides. Push back on first prices and agree on terms like view guarantees or performance-based pay.
* Build long-term relationships with creators and their managements, and decide how we work with them across both brands.
* Run frequent hypothesis-driven experiments. We put strong emphasis on asking the right questions, good experiment design, and generating actionable data and interpretations. You own large parts of creator and influencer experimentation.
* You continue to expand our creator database and context layer, allowing you to work very data and insight driven, and enabling AI agents to work alongside or for you equipped with the right data and context.
* Automate the repetitive parts of your job with n8n, Claude Cowork/Code and GitHub, so research, scoring and reporting run on their own and you can spend your time on higher value work with creators, negotiations, content and strategy.
* Seasonal campaign planning across multiple platforms, formats and creator sizes.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience running influencer campaigns on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, at a brand or an agency.
* You’re highly curious about the creator economy and thrive on turning complex, ambiguous challenges into practical solutions in a high-agency role.
* You’re an effective and confident negotiator who always strives to get the best deal and who’s not shy to walk away from a deal.
* You’re highly analytical and very comfortable with processing and critically interpreting data sets, with an eye for detail.
* You are on the path of becoming an AI builder with first basic to advanced workflow automations or other agentic solutions under your belt with measurable impact.
* You’re experienced in general in how to work with LLMs and agentic solutions effectively, including when to critically review their outputs.
* Strong communicator and relationship builder with both, internal stakeholders and external managements and creators. You’re fluent in German and English.

If you come from performance marketing, growth, affiliate or creator operations and have worked with creators, apply anyway. We'd like to hear from you.

**What your first 90 days look like**
-------------------------------------

* A creator pipeline where you can explain why each creator is on it.
* Working relationships with the creators and managements you book.
* Two structured experiments, with read-outs that say what failed as clearly as what worked.
* One recurring task automated, with the hours it saves measured.

**Why Taxfix?**
---------------

* A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.
* Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.
* A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.
* Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.
* 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.
* A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.
* Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.
* Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.
* Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.
* Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.

Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.*

job.title: Junior Shopper & Customer Marketing Manager DACH (m/w/d) @ Estrid (Berlin, BE, DE)
job.description:
Hey du,  
  
schön, dass du hier gelandet bist! Das heißt wohl, dass du dir vorstellen kannst, bei Estrid zu arbeiten – und das freut uns riesig. Hier erfährst du, was dich in dieser Rolle und bei uns erwartet.  
  
**Kurz und knapp:**  
Ganz ehrlich: Wir sind kein Unternehmen wie jedes andere. Wir sind ein Team aus Träumern und Machern mit einem klaren Ziel – eine der stärksten Consumer Brand der Welt aufzubauen. In den letzten Jahren haben wir mehr erreicht, als viele für möglich gehalten hätten, und uns zu einer echten Erfolgsgeschichte im Konsumgüterbereich entwickelt. Für uns ist das aber erst der Anfang – und wir freuen uns, wenn du das nächste Kapitel mit uns schreibst.  
  
**Deine Rolle & dein Impact:**  
Estrid ist eine nordische Beauty-Marke, die davon überzeugt ist, dass auch die ganz alltäglichen Momente deines Tages es verdienen, schön zu sein. Seit dem Launch 2019 haben wir mit preisgekrönten Rasierern und unserer Bodycare eine Community von Millionen Menschen aufgebaut. Du findest uns online und in immer mehr Regalen im europäischen Handel. Wir wachsen schnell – und die DACH-Region (Deutschland, Österreich, Schweiz) gehört zu unseren wichtigsten Märkten.  
  
Als Junior Shopper & Customer Marketing Manager DACH (m/w/d) bringst du Estrid am Point of Sale (POS) zum Leben – im gesamten DACH-Raum, mit Fokus auf Deutschland. Die Position ist remote, dein Wohnsitz liegt in Deutschland: Du arbeitest überwiegend aus dem Homeoffice und stehst im regen Austausch mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen in ganz Europa. Du berichtest an die Senior Key Account Managerin und kooperierst eng mit unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing und Global Trade Marketing. Dabei übersetzt du unsere Shopper-Marketing-Strategie in wirkungsvolle In-Store-Aktivierungen, Promotions und Produktlaunches, die unsere Marke stärken und den Abverkauf steigern.  
  
**Deine Aufgaben:**

* Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Shopper Marketing – intern (Marketing, CRM, Social, PR) und extern gegenüber den Retail Media Teams unserer Key Accounts in Drogerie und Lebensmitteleinzelhandel (LEH).
* Du übersetzt die globale Shopper-Strategie in kundenindividuelle Aktivierungspläne für die DACH-Region – von POS-Maßnahmen bis zu Retail-Media-Kampagnen entlang der gesamten Shopper Journey.
* Du pflegst den DACH-Aktions- und Promotionkalender und behältst alle laufenden Maßnahmen im Blick.
* Du koordinierst Aktivierungen, Promotions und Zweitplatzierungen und setzt sie termingerecht, vollständig und im Budget um – in enger Abstimmung mit Handelspartnern, Agenturen und Dienstleistern.
* Du erstellst überzeugende Aktions- und Promotionpräsentationen und unterstützt das Key Account Management bei Jahresgesprächen / der Joint Business Planning (JBP) mit dem Handel.
* Du entwickelst aufmerksamkeitsstarke POS-Materialien, Promotions und Merchandising-Lösungen, mit denen Estrid im Regal heraussticht – von Coupons über Displays bis hin zu Wobblern.
* Du analysierst Kampagnen- und Launch-Ergebnisse (z. B. Sell-out, Promotion-Performance) und teilst deine Learnings im gesamten Unternehmen.
* Du besuchst regelmäßig Filialen, prüfst die Umsetzung am POS und leitest aus Markttrends, Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Shopper Insights konkrete Maßnahmen für Estrid ab.

**Dein Profil:**

* Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Shopper Marketing, Trade Marketing oder Customer Marketing – idealerweise in der FMCG-/Konsumgüterbranche oder im Handel
* Gute Kenntnisse des deutschen Drogeriemarkts und des Lebensmitteleinzelhandels (LEH)
* Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen: Excel/Google Sheets, Sell-out-Daten und Reportings; erste Erfahrung mit Retail Media ist ein Plus
* Gute PowerPoint-/Google-Slides-Kenntnisse und ein gutes Auge für Gestaltung
* Hands-on-Mentalität, Eigeninitiative und viel Energie: Du packst gerne an und übernimmst Verantwortung
* Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte parallel in einem dynamischen Scale-up zu steuern
* Kommunikationsstärke und Freude daran, Beziehungen zu Handelspartnern und zu einem europaweit verteilten Estrid-Team aufzubauen
* Selbstständiges Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie Reisebereitschaft für regelmäßige Store-Besuche

**Ausbildung & Qualifikationen:**

* Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Marketing oder Kommunikation) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

**Sprachen & Sonstiges:**

* Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau
* Fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

**Das Umfeld, in dem du aufblühst:**  
  
Die Estrid-Kultur besteht nicht aus schönen Sprüchen an der Wand – sie ist die Grundlage für alles, was wir tun. Dabei zählt das Verhalten jedes Einzelnen. Einige unserer Werte: Speed, Stay Hungry, High Standards und Keep It Simple.  
  
**Team & Standorte:**  
  
Wir sind ein motiviertes, ambitioniertes Team mit Büros in Stockholm und London und arbeiten eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in ganz Europa zusammen. Inzwischen sind wir rund 70 Mitarbeitende in Vollzeit, ein Drittel davon mit internationalem Hintergrund. Unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch.  
  
**Werde Teil von Estrid!**  
  
Bei Estrid zählen Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem du so willkommen bist, wie du bist. Denn je mehr Perspektiven wir im Team vereinen, desto besser können wir uns entfalten, wachsen und Mehrwert schaffen. Unsere Community ist für alle da – und das gilt genauso für unseren Arbeitsplatz.  
  
Du bist neugierig, packst Herausforderungen mit Energie an und möchtest den Alltag unserer Kundinnen und Kunden noch ein Stück schöner machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!  
  
Stay kind,  
Estrid
